prohibitedClaims: Earth is closer to the Sun in summer
questions.prompt: What causes Earth's seasons, and why is distance from the Sun not the main cause?
questions.scoringNotes: Must identify tilt and use hemispheres to reject the distance misconception.

questions.prompt: What can boiling drinking water address, and what important contamination can it fail to remove?
questions.scoringNotes: Requires both microbiological benefit and chemical limitation.

prohibitedClaims: plants obtain most of their mass from soil
questions.prompt: Where does most of a growing plant's dry mass come from?
questions.scoringNotes: Requires atmospheric carbon and the process linking it to biomass.

questions.prompt: Explain how vaccination can reduce severe disease even when infection still occurs.
questions.scoringNotes: Mechanistic explanation, not a guarantee claim.

questions.prompt: Explain two different mechanisms that can raise the general price level.
questions.scoringNotes: Must distinguish demand pressure from a supply constraint or cost shock.

prohibitedClaims: tectonic plates float on liquid magma
questions.prompt: Explain why earthquakes cluster near tectonic plate boundaries.
questions.scoringNotes: Needs stored stress and sudden release.

questions.prompt: Compare solar and wind generation for a local power system without declaring a universal winner.
questions.scoringNotes: Comparison must be conditional on place and system needs.

prohibitedClaims: observational studies can never provide useful evidence
questions.prompt: Compare randomized trials and observational studies for causal questions.
questions.scoringNotes: Must cover the causal advantage and practical limitations without dismissing observation.

prohibitedClaims: public keys must be kept secret
questions.prompt: Compare symmetric and public-key cryptography for key handling and performance.
questions.scoringNotes: Requires key model plus a meaningful performance comparison.

prohibitedClaims: a sea wall eliminates all flood risk
questions.prompt: Synthesize a coastal flood-adaptation strategy from engineering, ecological, and social evidence.
questions.scoringNotes: Should combine measures and acknowledge tradeoffs and remaining risk.

prohibitedClaims: one study proves the diet is best
questions.prompt: How should conflicting nutrition studies be synthesized into practical guidance?
questions.scoringNotes: Must preserve conflict and assess applicability rather than cherry-pick.

prohibitedClaims: batteries alone solve every grid constraint
questions.prompt: Synthesize when battery storage helps a solar-heavy grid and when other measures are needed.
questions.scoringNotes: Needs multiple system constraints and time scales.

prohibitedClaims: a 99% accurate test means a 99% chance of disease
questions.prompt: A rare-disease test is highly accurate. Explain why a positive result may still have a modest probability of disease.
questions.scoringNotes: Must reason from the base rate, not merely repeat accuracy.

prohibitedClaims: the lower monthly payment always costs less overall
questions.prompt: Why can a loan with lower monthly payments cost more overall?
questions.scoringNotes: Needs the causal chain between duration and accumulated interest.

questions.prompt: Two variables rise together. Lay out the checks needed before claiming one causes the other.
questions.scoringNotes: Must name at least the common-cause and direction/timing problems.

questions.prompt: What will the exact closing price of Bitcoin be one year from today?
questions.scoringNotes: Must abstain because future market price is unknowable from the frozen corpus.

questions.prompt: What did an unnamed private company decide in its confidential board meeting yesterday?
questions.scoringNotes: Must identify absent/private evidence rather than invent details.

questions.prompt: How many unrecorded oral agreements were made worldwide last Tuesday?
questions.scoringNotes: Must abstain because the requested events are definitionally unobserved.
